# Scraper-Swarm gateway contract fixtures (v1)

Vendored from the gateway repo for recorded-fixture contract tests
(Heretek-AI/IUMBTEMS#107, ADR 0001 protocol-only integration).

- fixtures-from: scraper-swarm@e1b295523402a07443f1e88f7add356907b3ba3b
  (`integration/gateway-v1`; golden fixtures from Heretek-AI/scraper-swarm#8,
  `contract/v1/fixtures/`, generated by
  `apps/gateway/tests/gen_contract_fixtures.py`, drift-pinned by
  `test_contract_drift.py` there).
- Scope: `web-search/`, `fetch-page/`, `tools-list/`, `tools-call/`,
  `initialize/`, `rate-limited/` (the tools this ticket's backend calls).
  `deep-research/` and `stealth-scrape/` are out of scope for #107.
- Volatile fields are normalized upstream: `fetched_at` is `<fetched_at>`,
  `Retry-After` is `<retry_after_s>` (assert presence, not value).
- Re-vendor on every contract-version bump. The contract tests fail when a
  fixture's `contract_version` differs from the client's expected major.
